schema_note: Merged enriched unification card. Sections: original_card (the U019 candidate as supplied), source_verification (independent line-checks against the cited papers), audit (compression/baseline/anti-superficiality controls as supplied), skeptic_panel (4 adversarial referees as supplied), repair_and_scoring (this Test-Hardener+Fertility-Judge pass), then triage fields. All load-bearing claims were independently verified against source .tex: To_Cast_a_Stone (lines 89,110,114,166,178,217,251,261,296,298,357,393,395,397,406,415,519-544), Six_Birds_No_Go_Theorems (lines 176,178,303-332,415,439-446,673,693,722), Holonomy_with_Memory (lines 115,125,205,340,447-475,767). Quotes <=25 words. SBT self-disclaimers honored; gaps marked. All numerics (CD_1=4.34e-17, RM^uniform_1=5.29e-17, residual<=2.87e-16, r=0.959 uniform-lift, alpha-sweep 0.00827->0.0482) read from the frozen benchmark summaries in To_Cast_a_Stone sec:results-markov.

Variational identity is the NG_MACRO_CLOSURE_DEFICIT theorem (No-Go line 415) with best macro kernel lem (No-Go line 722); Csiszar concession VERIFIED, No-Go line 326 'the variational minimizer below is a finite KL-projection viewpoint [Csiszar1975]' and line 693 'the variational minimizer is a finite KL-projection instance'.

Although Prop rm-lower-bound is stated for the stationary-conditioned route mismatch, the cheaper operational mismatch already serves as a practical proxy'.

D3 BRIDGE VERIFIED ABSENT: Cast never cites the Holonomy paper; its only 'holonomy' tokens are the P3 primitive label 'protocol holonomy / route mismatch' (lines 96,125). Cast cites Shalizi-Crutchfield ONLY as external tradition (line 114): 'Computational mechanics similarly isolates predictive sufficiency ... Our contribution is different in emphasis'.

Holonomy DECLINES causal-state identification, VERIFIED line 115: 'The present paper does not identify PredictiveQ with any one of those formalisms'; line 767: 'The paper does not claim to subsume those frameworks'; line 125: results 'are individually standard'.

Disjoint state spaces VERIFIED Holonomy line 466: 'the exact finite quotients CurrentQ and PredictiveQ are computed by exact equality of signature vectors'; line 475: 'the present quotients are defined by event signatures rather than by preservation of the Markov property under aggregation' -- NOT the same object as conditional MI on a Markov chain.
verified_false_or_unsupported: The headline 'three-domain duality' is NOT supported: the D3 leg's bridging lemma (CD_tau=0 <=> single-lag predictive sufficiency in the Holonomy/causal-state sense) is absent and the two formalisms do not share a state space.

Treating D2 as an independent third(/second) domain doing separate work is partly inflationary: D2 is the SAME finite stationary Markov substrate as D4; the 'D2 noise budget' IS the exact split H(Y|Y)=H(Y|X)+CD computed on the identical object. The genuine claim is 'one object, two readings of one identity', not mechanism reuse across two physically distinct domains.
source_verification.no_disclaimer_crossed: Confirmed: no Born rule, no continuum/Lorentz/Fock, no RG flow (NG_LADDER_IDEM honored), CD>0 is NOT read as irreversibility/entropy production (disclaimer 13 honored), lens Pi is a free input (MISS_LENS_SEL flagged), hashing/one-wayness scoped OUT entirely (unlike R029).

original_card.one_sentence_claim: The closure deficit CD_tau(Pi)=I(X_t;Y_{t+tau}|Y_t) is a single exact conditional-mutual-information obstruction whose vanishing simultaneously IS exact Markov lumpability / a closed effective macro law (D4) and, via a moderate-difficulty bridging lemma, IS single-lag predictive sufficiency / screening-off of the micro past from the packaged future (D3), both computed on one finite stationary Markov substrate (D2); so 'the coarse dynamics closes' and 'the coarse state screens off the future' are observable-preserving duals -- they agree on the best-macro-kernel K* and every f-definable predictive statistic -- differing only in which side of the exact split H(Y_{t+tau}|Y_t)=H(Y_{t+tau}|X_t)+CD_tau one reads.
domains_unified: D3 (information theory: predictive sufficiency / computational-mechanics causal states)
D2 (statistical mechanics of finite coarse-grained effective dynamics)
original_card.argument_family: duality-unification (one scalar conditional-MI obstruction whose vanishing is jointly characterized two ways under one observable-preserving lens)
original_card.shared_mechanism: A single scalar information obstruction, the closure deficit CD_tau(Pi)=I(X_t;Y_{t+tau}|Y_t), carrying the exact decomposition H(Y_{t+tau}|Y_t)=H(Y_{t+tau}|X_t)+CD_tau and the variational identity CD_tau=min_K L_tau(K)=L_tau(K*) with K*_y=Law(Y_{t+tau}|Y_t=y) (a finite Csiszar-1975 KL-projection). The SAME object does double duty: its vanishing is the closure side (dynamics admits a closed macro kernel = lumpability) and the sufficiency side (the coarse state screens micro past from packaged future). It is an audit-DPI / conditional-MI relative of the one-monotonicity audit functional A (R028): both are nonnegative information quantities monotone under coarsening, here specialized to a conditional MI rather than a path-KL.
original_card.minimum_viable_unification: A self-contained note proving (all already in the papers) that CD_tau(Pi)=I(X_t;Y_{t+tau}|Y_t) is the exact observable-preserving obstruction whose vanishing IS lumpability / a closed effective law (D4, exact at tau=1, prop:cd-zero) and -- via the new single-lag bridging lemma -- IS single-lag predictive sufficiency / screening-off (D3), both computed on one finite stationary Markov substrate (D2), with the No-Go best-macro-kernel variational identity fixing the shared observable K*, the exact intrinsic-vs-manufactured noise split, the Pinsker route-mismatch bound (r=0.959, uniform lift flagged), the controlled Markov benchmark (CD_1~4.34e-17, residual <=2.87e-16), and the Lean KL step as evidence.
original_card.note: Full theory_basis, bridge_dictionary, domain_derivations, proof_route, stronger_unification, bottlenecks, fallback, baseline_comparison, why_scientists_care, target_audience, recommended_artifact, execution_cost, builds_on_retro_cards (R029,R028,R018) and honest_status_note are as supplied in the task card and are not re-transcribed here to avoid duplication; the repair_and_scoring section below records every binding change.

compression.hidden_import_risk: HIGH on the D3 leg: predictive sufficiency is not derived from CD_tau but imported as a within-paper slogan plus an external Shalizi-Crutchfield citation. The cross-formalism bridging lemma is VERIFIED ABSENT (Cast does not cite Holonomy; objects on different state spaces; Holonomy declines causal-state identification). The D4/D2 compression is genuine but near-tautological: per Cast line 261, CD_tau=0<=>lumpable is an elementary conditional-MI chain-rule rebranding of Kemeny-Snell/Buchholz. Free-param count barely moves (free lens Pi, tau, lift choice, predictor budget, choice of which facts to call 'dual' all persist); compression is in conceptual packaging, not parametric economy.

baseline.natural_baseline: B_EFT (effective field theory / RG / Mori-Zwanzig) for D4/D2; Shalizi-Crutchfield computational mechanics for D3; Csiszar-1975 KL-projection for the variational identity.
theory_advantage: Exact split H(Y_{t+tau}|Y_t)=H(Y_{t+tau}|X_t)+CD_tau cleanly separates irreducible substrate uncertainty from lens-manufactured non-closure -- a useful diagnostic the bare EFT/lumpability statements do not foreground.
Exactly computable in finite benchmarks (CD_1~4.34e-17 on lumpable cases, residual<=2.87e-16) with a cheap, provably controlling Pinsker route-mismatch proxy.
A Lean-checked KL step anchors the divergence reading; one scalar carries closure and (informally) sufficiency, giving real expository compression.
theory_disadvantage: Strictly WEAKER than EFT: NG_LADDER_IDEM forbids an RG semigroup -- coarse-graining without flow; no beta functions, no universality, no critical exponents.
In its home domain (D_INFO) deflation lands hardest: monotone divergences, conditional MI, lumpability and causal-state theory are all textbook; SBT names rather than beats them.
The D3 leg does not reach the Shalizi-Crutchfield baseline -- the bridging lemma is absent and the Holonomy quotient lives in a different formalism.
Exact lumpability holds cleanly only at tau=1; tau>1 is the generally-weaker lag-tau closedness.

same_word.note: 'Closure' and 'sufficiency' are genuinely two readings of the SAME scalar CD_tau=0, not a pun. The one term-overload risk ('predictive sufficiency' = within-paper single-lag slogan vs Holonomy/Shalizi-Crutchfield causal states) is honestly flagged.

shared_mechanism.note: One scalar CMI obstruction does identical work for D4 (CD=0<=>lumpable) and D2 (the H(Y|X)+CD split) on ONE substrate. But it is only TWO domains of genuine reuse; D3 rides on the same object via an unproved bridge, so the 'three-domain' headline is two-domain mechanism + one adjacency.

bridge_map.note: D4/D2 bridge maps are writable and observable-preserving (agree on K*_y=Law(Y_{t+tau}|Y_t=y)). The D3 bridge map is NOT writable: it requires the lemma marked already_in_papers:false. Cast does not cite Holonomy; objects do not share a state space; Holonomy disclaims causal-state identification. FAILS for the full three-domain claim.

hidden_import.note: The D3 'sufficiency' face is imported, not derived: CD_tau=0 is REDEFINED as single-lag sufficiency rather than shown to coincide with an independent sufficiency object. CD=0<=>lumpable is (Cast line 261) classical lumpability restated as a conditional MI.

elasticity.note: Inherits lens-selection elasticity (R029/R028/R018; lens Pi free, MISS_LENS_SEL). The rigorous legs are mathematical IDENTITIES, so no false instance can be retrodicted but they carry no empirical content; any non-closing partition is read as 'CD>0, manufactured randomness'. R029 opposite_world_test could_explain_opposite=true.

compression.note: Marginally passes: real conceptual compression of two established facts under one elementary identity plus the noise-budget split, but compression of EXPOSITION, not of assumptions/parameters.

surprise.note: No new relation/constraint/forbidden case beyond relabeling. Matched numbers are calibration/regression certificates of identities that MUST hold. The 'duality' is a true but expository equivalence; the noise split is a one-line chain-rule consequence.

audit.audit_verdict: PARTIAL UNIFICATION / RECOVERY + REORGANIZATION, NOT A NEW UNIFICATION; HIGH MISFRAMING RISK. Genuine asset: the scalar CD_tau does double duty across D4 and D2 via the exact split and the Csiszar KL-projection identity, with a Pinsker-bounded route-mismatch proxy (r=0.959, uniform-lift heuristic correctly flagged) and a Lean-checked KL step -- beating the crude 'quotient-in-costume' deflation in one checkable way (a single nonnegative scalar, not a quotient; genuine information geometry). BUT the three-domain headline fails: D3 rests on a VERIFIED-ABSENT bridging lemma; the load-bearing D4 leg is self-admitted lumpability rebranding (line 261); NG_LADDER_IDEM makes SBT strictly weaker than B_EFT; the lens is free and the rigorous legs are identities (elasticity inherited). 4 of 7 anti-superficial controls pass; bridge_map, hidden_import, elasticity, surprise fail for the headline. Defensible deliverable = the card's own fallback: a two-domain (D4+D2) exact-decomposition diagnostic note with D3 demoted to the within-paper single-lag slogan plus informal adjacency. No SBT disclaimer crossed.

skeptics.skeptic_role: Nonequilibrium statistical physicist (entropy production, coarse-graining pitfalls, fluctuation theorems).
skeptics.main_objection: The advertised THREE-domain duality collapses to a genuine TWO-domain recovery (D4 lumpability + D2 noise-budget split) plus one absent bridge. The D3 leg rests on a bridging lemma marked already_in_papers:false and verified absent (Cast never cites Holonomy/PredictiveQ/future-sufficiency/screening-off; objects do not share a state space). What survives is one nontrivial info-geometric identity doing double duty across D4/D2 -- which DOES beat the crude quotient-in-costume deflation because CD_tau is a single scalar -- but D4 is self-admitted lumpability rebranding (line 261). Recovery + reorganization, not new three-domain unification.

skeptics.skeptic_role: Skeptical information theorist / RG skeptic (DPI, sufficiency, KL-projection fixed points, universality).
skeptics.main_objection: Only TWO of the three legs share the mechanism; D3 rests on a verified-absent bridging lemma and the 'predictive sufficiency' face is redefined as CD_tau=0 (hidden import). The surviving content is a real but two-domain duality (D4+D2 on one substrate), and even that is, per author's own admission (Cast line 261; No-Go 326/693), classical lumpability plus an elementary chain-rule identity -- recovery, not new content.

skeptics.skeptic_role: Skeptical mathematical physicist / information theorist auditing whether bridge maps are explicit and observable-preserving.
skeptics.main_objection: The headline's load-bearing identifications are either an admitted relabeling (D4, line 261) or an absent bridge (D3, verified). The D3 bridge map is not writable and not observable-preserving; the sufficiency face is imported as a within-paper slogan. What survives is a real but modest TWO-domain (D4+D2) recovery: one scalar nonnegative obstruction carrying an exact noise split. Reorganization, not three-domain unification.
fatal_objections: D3 bridging lemma VERIFIED ABSENT: Cast does not cite Holonomy; objects do not share a state space; Holonomy lines 115/767 decline causal-state identification. The crux observable-preserving bridge map for the third domain is missing.
The causal-state identification is not derived from CD_tau; CD_tau=0 is REDEFINED as single-lag sufficiency -- a hidden import on the only leg that would make this more than a two-domain story.

skeptics.skeptic_role: Hostile cross-domain referee with joint standing in stat-mech coarse-graining (Mori-Zwanzig, lumpability) and computational mechanics (causal states, DPI).
skeptics.main_objection: The three-domain duality headline is false: a genuine TWO-domain recovery (D4+D2) glued to D3 only by a verified-absent bridging lemma. The two rigorous legs are one object only because CD_tau=0 is, by the author's own admission (line 261), classical Kemeny-Snell/Buchholz lumpability restated as a conditional MI. A computational-mechanics specialist would not accept the D3 map; the stat-mech specialist accepts only what was already lumpability. Joint specialist acceptance fails for the headline.
fatal_objections: Headline three-domain unification rests on a VERIFIED-ABSENT bridging lemma; Cast's only 'holonomy' tokens are the P3 primitive label, not citations; Holonomy lines 115/767 decline subsumption; line 466/475 confirm signature-vector (not Markov-preservation) semantics. The crux D3 observable-preserving bridge map does not exist.

repair_and_scoring.repair_disposition: REPAIRED BY NARROWING from a THREE-domain duality-unification to a defensible TWO-domain (D4 closure + D2 noise-split) RECOVERY + REORGANIZATION under one exact conditional-MI identity, with the D3 predictive-sufficiency leg explicitly DEMOTED to a flagged conjecture (the within-paper single-lag sufficiency slogan + explicit informal adjacency to Shalizi-Crutchfield, NOT an identification). This is the card's own scoped fallback, promoted to the headline. Rationale: the panel is decisive against the three-domain claim (is_real_unification 0/4; beats_deflation 1/4; a fatal objection present; D3 bridge VERIFIED ABSENT in source; bridge_map/hidden_import/elasticity/surprise controls fail for the headline). UNLIKE U018 (rejected, because there the shared mechanism did genuine COMPUTATIONAL work on exactly ONE substrate), here the shared scalar CD_tau does genuine, identical, non-imported work across the D4 closure reading AND the D2 intrinsic-vs-manufactured noise split on ONE finite stationary Markov substrate -- a real two-reading equivalence of one nontrivial information-geometric identity. Two of four skeptics (2.5) and the audit grant this two-domain core survives and beats the crude quotient-in-costume deflation. So the unification is not rejected outright; it is repaired into an honest two-domain recovery/diagnostic with a clearly-flagged open bridge. Caveat on counting: D2 is the SAME substrate as D4, so 'two domains' here means 'one substrate, two distinct established questions (closure-of-dynamics and the noise decomposition) read off one identity', which is the maximal honest claim.
allowed_repairs_applied: NARROWED the unification: three-domain duality -> two-domain (D4+D2) recovery; the headline no longer asserts a third domain.

ADMITTED a domain is only sketched/absent: D3 is demoted from 'derived via a moderate bridging lemma' to a FLAGGED CONJECTURE (the bridging lemma is verified absent; the two formalisms do not share a state space; Holonomy explicitly declines causal-state identification).

CLARIFIED the bridge map: the D4 and D2 bridge maps ARE writable and observable-preserving (both readings agree on K*_y=Law(Y_{t+tau}|Y_t=y) and on every f-definable predictive statistic); the D3 bridge map is stated as MISSING, not informal-but-present.

REPLACED analogy with explicit relation where possible: the D4<->D2 link is stated as the exact algebraic identity H(Y_{t+tau}|Y_t)=H(Y_{t+tau}|X_t)+CD_tau plus the Csiszar KL-projection variational identity, not as an analogy.

CONVERTED vague emergence into a precise limiting/coarse-graining statement: the D4 claim is restated as 'CD_tau=0 <=> lag-tau closedness, which is exact classical Kemeny-Snell/Buchholz lumpability ONLY at tau=1; for tau>1 it is the generally-weaker lag-tau closedness' (per Cast line 261).

Added the honest scoping of matched numbers: CD_1=4.34e-17 (residual<=2.87e-16) and r=0.959 are FROZEN CALIBRATION/REGRESSION CERTIFICATES of identities that must hold, NOT out-of-sample predictions; and r=0.959 uses the uniform lift, NOT the stationary lift for which Pinsker (prop:rm-lower-bound) is proved -- so it is a heuristic proxy outside the proved bound.
repair_and_scoring.forbidden_repairs_checked: No forbidden move used: no assumption added per domain (the repair REMOVES the third domain rather than propping it up); no terms redefined to force equivalence (the D3 redefinition-as-sufficiency was the original sin and is exactly what is demoted); no imported physics hidden (the Csiszar KL-projection and Kemeny-Snell/Buchholz lumpability imports are stated explicitly); no duality claimed without a map (the surviving D4/D2 duality has an explicit observable-preserving map on K*; D3 is openly mapless); no emergence claimed without a limit (the coarse-graining-without-RG-flow restriction is stated, NG_LADDER_IDEM honored).
repair_and_scoring.revised_one_sentence_claim: On one finite stationary Markov substrate, the closure deficit CD_tau(Pi)=I(X_t;Y_{t+tau}|Y_t) is a single nonnegative scalar conditional-MI obstruction that, via the exact split H(Y_{t+tau}|Y_t)=H(Y_{t+tau}|X_t)+CD_tau and the Csiszar best-macro-kernel variational identity, simultaneously IS the obstruction to a closed effective macro law (D4: CD_tau=0 <=> lag-tau closedness, = exact Kemeny-Snell/Buchholz lumpability only at tau=1) AND the exact decomposition of observed coarse-grained noise into irreducible substrate uncertainty plus lens-manufactured non-closure (D2), the two readings agreeing on the shared observable K*_y=Law(Y_{t+tau}|Y_t=y); the predictive-sufficiency / Shalizi-Crutchfield causal-state reading (D3) is an explicitly-flagged OPEN CONJECTURE pending a bridging lemma that is verified absent (Cast does not cite Holonomy and the two formalisms do not share a state space), so it is offered only as the within-paper single-lag sufficiency slogan plus informal adjacency.
repair_and_scoring.new_minimum_viable_unification: A short rigorous note proving (all already in the papers) that CD_tau(Pi)=I(X_t;Y_{t+tau}|Y_t) is THE exact observable-preserving obstruction to a closed effective macro law on a finite stationary Markov substrate, recovering Kemeny-Snell/Buchholz lumpability as CD_tau=0 at tau=1 (lag-tau closedness for tau>1; prop:cd-zero), with (i) the exact intrinsic-vs-manufactured noise split (D2; prop:cd-decomposition), (ii) the No-Go best-macro-kernel variational identity fixing the shared observable K* (acknowledged finite Csiszar-1975 KL-projection), (iii) the Pinsker route-mismatch bound CD_tau>=(1/2)(RM^stat)^2 (prop:rm-lower-bound; proved for the stationary lift, with the reported r=0.959 explicitly labeled a uniform-lift heuristic proxy outside the proved bound), (iv) the controlled Markov benchmark (CD_1=4.34e-17, residual<=2.87e-16, alpha-sweep 0.00827->0.0482) labeled a calibration certificate, and (v) the modest Lean KL-bridge module as the machine-checked anchor. MVU = two ESTABLISHED stat-mech/info facts (closure/lumpability and the noise decomposition) unified under one elementary exact conditional-MI identity on one substrate, with the D3 predictive-sufficiency / causal-state leg, the stochastic-lens extension (MISS_STOCH_LENS), and the full conditional-MI Lean mechanization listed as clearly-flagged open obligations.
changes_made: Dropped the THREE-domain framing; headline is now a TWO-domain (D4+D2) recovery+reorganization on one substrate.

Demoted D3 from 'derived (sketched)' to FLAGGED OPEN CONJECTURE: the bridging lemma is verified absent; do not claim identification with the Holonomy PredictiveQ or with Shalizi-Crutchfield causal states.
Restated D4 precisely as lag-tau closedness, exact lumpability ONLY at tau=1 (per Cast line 261); removed the unqualified 'CD=0 IS lumpability'.
Labeled all matched numbers (CD_1=4.34e-17, residual<=2.87e-16, r=0.959) as frozen calibration/regression certificates of identities that must hold, not predictions.
Reconciled the lift: r=0.959 is the UNIFORM-lift proxy; the proved Pinsker bound is for the STATIONARY lift -- flagged as a heuristic outside the proved bound.

Stated the Csiszar-1975 KL-projection (No-Go 326/693) and Kemeny-Snell/Buchholz lumpability (Cast 261) imports explicitly; the contribution is the unifying exact-split reading + falsifiable diagnostic, not new information geometry.
Kept disclaimer 13 (CD>0 is NOT irreversibility/entropy production) traveling with every 'noise budget' phrasing, and NG_LADDER_IDEM (coarse-graining WITHOUT RG flow) explicit in the scope.
Noted the D2/D4 counting caveat: D2 is the same substrate as D4, so 'two domains' = one substrate, two distinct established questions read off one identity.
remaining_objections: Even after repair, the surviving content is RECOVERY + REORGANIZATION, not a new unification: D4 is self-admitted lumpability rebranding and the variational identity is an admitted Csiszar KL-projection; the surprise control still fails (no constraint or forbidden case the separate textbook accounts did not entail).
Against B_EFT, SBT remains strictly weaker: NG_LADDER_IDEM forbids an RG semigroup, so coarse-graining without flow -- no universality, exponents, or running couplings.

Elasticity is inherited and not removable by repair: the lens Pi is a free input (MISS_LENS_SEL) and the rigorous legs are identities; the matched numbers are calibration/regression certificates, not predictions.
The D3 leg remains absent until the bridging lemma is proved in one shared finite-Markov formalism (and the all-lag causal-state identification is harder still; Holonomy explicitly declines it).
The two-domain claim is the weaker reading of a single stat-mech identity (D2 lives on the same substrate as D4), so 'breadth' is genuinely thin.
repair_and_scoring.what_would_upgrade: A written, checked proof of the single-lag bridging lemma on the SAME finite stationary Markov substrate carrying CD_tau -- showing CD_tau(Pi)=0 <=> Y_t is single-lag predictively sufficient (screening-off) in exactly the computational-mechanics sense, with an explicit observable-preserving bridge map -- would restore a genuine third domain and convert this from a two-domain recovery into a real three-domain duality. Lifting to all-lag sufficiency (identifying M with Shalizi-Crutchfield causal states), extending CD_tau to stochastic-kernel lenses (MISS_STOCH_LENS), and mechanizing the full conditional-MI decomposition in Lean would further strengthen it. Additionally, exhibiting ANY new constraint/forbidden case the separate accounts do not entail would move it past pure recovery.

score_rationale.impact: 2: a clean exact-decomposition diagnostic is genuinely useful to coarse-graining practitioners (intrinsic vs lens-manufactured noise), but it is a reframing/diagnostic, not a result that changes any field's understanding; deflation lands hardest in its home domain.
score_rationale.execution_ease: 4: the core theorems are ALREADY proved and partly Lean-checked, numerics frozen in the companion repo; assembling the two-domain note is days. (Not 5 because the bridging-lemma upgrade and Lean conditional-MI mechanization are real separate efforts, but those are out of the MVU.)
score_rationale.plausibility: 4: the surviving two-domain content is mathematically correct and verified against source; high confidence it holds. Not 5 because the framing/counting (treating D2 as separate from D4) invites overstatement.
score_rationale.depth_of_unification: 2: depth is capped by the analogical-only D3 bridge being removed and by D4 being a definitional restatement; the genuine depth is one exact identity with two readings on one substrate -- real but shallow (a chain-rule split + a KL-projection).
score_rationale.breadth_of_unification: 1: after honest repair this is effectively one finite stationary Markov substrate read two ways (closure + noise split); the third domain is absent. Genuinely narrow.
score_rationale.non_ad_hocness: 2: capped by failed hidden_import (D3 sufficiency redefined as CD=0) and the self-admitted lumpability/Csiszar imports; the surviving D4/D2 split is not ad hoc but is near-tautological.
score_rationale.bridge_explicitness: 2: capped because the bridge_map control FAILS for the headline (D3 map verified absent). The D4/D2 maps ARE explicit and observable-preserving (agree on K*), which keeps it off 1.
score_rationale.derivational_strength: 3: the D4/D2 identities are fully proved (prop:cd-decomposition, prop:cd-kl, prop:cd-zero, NG_MACRO_CLOSURE_DEFICIT, prop:rm-lower-bound) and one KL step is Lean-checked; but the proofs are elementary/standard and the D3 derivation is absent.
score_rationale.compression_power: 2: compression is of EXPOSITION, not of independent assumptions/parameters (free-param count barely moves); the compression anti-superficial control passes only marginally.
score_rationale.discriminative_power: 1: capped by merely_repackages=true and failed surprise/elasticity controls -- the rigorous legs are identities that forbid no outcome; matched numbers are certificates of must-hold identities, not predictions.
score_rationale.audience_legibility: 4: the closure-deficit / noise-budget story is clean, teachable, and exactly computable; stat-mech and info-theory readers parse it immediately.
score_rationale.robustness: 3: the two-domain core is robust (verified identities, Lean anchor, frozen benchmark), but the headline was fragile (three-domain claim collapsed) and lift/lag caveats temper it.
score_rationale.baseline_advantage: 1: capped by merely_repackages=true and beats_baseline 0/4; strictly weaker than B_EFT (no RG flow) and names rather than beats textbook info theory; the only edge is the diagnostic framing.
score_rationale.adversarial_survival: 2: panel mean 2.25, min 1.5, fatal present, is_real_unification 0/4, beats_deflation 1/4. The two-domain core survives (it beats the crude quotient-in-costume deflation in one checkable way) but the headline does not; score reflects honoring the panel verdict.
score_rationale.publication_potential: 3: the two-domain exact-decomposition diagnostic note IS publishable as a clean methods/diagnostics contribution (with the Lean anchor and reproducible benchmark), provided it is framed honestly as recovery+diagnostic and the D3 leg is a flagged conjecture; not higher because there is no new result and the home-domain deflation is strong.

bin_rationale: Bin A (immediate quick win) for the REPAIRED two-domain deliverable: the core theorems are already proved and partly Lean-checked, the numerics are frozen in github.com/ioannist/six-birds-randomness, and the honest exact-decomposition diagnostic note is days of assembly. It is NOT bin B (skeptic-resistant structural) because, as the panel unanimously found, the structural three-domain claim does not survive and the surviving content is recovery+reorganization, not a skeptic-resistant new unification.
